sloka: इत्येवं दैवतैरुक्तो देवदेवो जनार्दनः ।अभयं भयदो ऽरीणां दत्त्वा देवानुवाच ह ।। ७.६.१९ ॥
transliteration: ityevaṁ daivatairukto devadevo janārdanaḥ ।abhayaṁ bhayado 'rīṇāṁ dattvā devānuvāca ha ।। 7.6.19 ॥

translations.english: O God, just as the sun dispels mist, you should dispel our fear by destroying these wicked, arrogant Rakshasas and their followers in battle.
translations.hindi: हे रघूत्तम ! उन राच्षासों ने हर्षित अन्तःकरण से, शिल्पियों में श्रेष्ठ, चिरंजीवी विश्वकमा के समीप जा कर कहा,
